comment: The MIDI mapping in the 2.41.1 code is written for a Launch Control XL MK2 for testing: control changes 13 to 19 move SM4, SM2, M4, SM3, SM1, M3 and Center in that order, and 29 and 30 move M1 and M2. The Epic knob has no control change of its own, and the comments in the code name different knobs from the ones the mapping table actually reaches. The panel's own right-click menu is empty; the MIDI driver and device lists are opened by left-clicking the MIDI button.
